prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the previous white-background / graphite-card Klipper printing screen. Produce ONE updated raster UI screenshot, flat front-facing, same landscape 5:3 aspect ratio, approximately 1600 x 960. Preserve the existing icon designs, typography style, rounded corners, labels, filename, numbers and central Aperture image, with ONLY the layout and color changes specified below.

STRUCTURAL CHANGE — REQUIRED:
COMPLETELY REMOVE THE ENTIRE TOP HEADER BAR, including the dark full-width rectangle, "APERTURE" header word, "IMPRIMIENDO" title, connection-status dot, "KLIPPER" word, and Wi-Fi symbol. None of those header elements may appear anywhere in the output. Do not add a replacement header, title, status row or caption. The resulting screen starts immediately with the main left information card and the first row of action cards, with just a narrow white outer margin.
Expand and rearrange the main content to fully reclaim that deleted header space. The left information card and the six action cards now use essentially the entire height of the screen, with equal top and bottom margins and consistent narrow gutters. Keep the established two-zone layout: left information card about 43% width, right two equal columns of three buttons about 55% width.
Precise reference geometry in an 800 x 480 coordinate system (scale all positions by two for 1600 x 960): white screen background; left information card x12,y12,w334,h456; first action column x360,w208; second action column x580,w208. Three button rows y12,h144; y168,h144; y324,h144. This creates slim 12-pixel outer margins and slim consistent gaps. Left card aligns with top of first button row and bottom of third button row. Fill reclaimed space intelligently by enlarging the central artwork and comfortably spacing its text and temperature rows, without clutter.

EXACT PALETTE:
- Screen background and all narrow gutters: laboratory white #E8ECEB.
- Left card, all six button-card fills and inset temperature-card fills: solid graphite black #20272B.
- DANGEROUS ACTION ICONS: CANCELAR circular X and PARADA circular stop-square use signal red #D94A3A.
- ALL OTHER ACTION ICONS: PAUSAR pause-bars, MACROS terminal, EXCLUIR stacked-layers, AJUSTES IMPRESION gear use portal orange #FF8A1C.
- The small BOQUILLA nozzle icon and CAMA heated-bed icon remain steel grey #4B575D.
- EVERY TEXT VALUE THAT WAS ORANGE in the input becomes STEEL GREY #4B575D. This specifically includes "63 %", "/210 °C" and "/60 °C". No orange letters, orange numbers or orange textual values remain. Orange is exclusively for the four non-dangerous action icons.
- Other labels and actual temperature readings remain off-white #E8ECEB, as in the reference. Keep actual readings 207 and 60. Secondary labels can remain light muted grey.
- Keep thin neutral card borders, subtle corner rounding, matte flat fills. No glow, shadows, texture, gradients or bevels.

IMAGES — PRESERVE ORIGINAL COLOR:
The large circular cyan-and-black Aperture illustration in the left card is an actual IMAGE / artwork. It must retain its original bright cyan blades, black circle/rim, dark center and black separators. Do not recolor it orange or grey. It may be resized proportionately for the enlarged left panel, keeping its exact blade geometry and proportions.

CONTENT:
Left card retains filename "aperture_companion_cube.gcode", the cyan Aperture illustration, "NO DATA", "PROGRESO", "63 %", "BOQUILLA", "207", "/210 °C", "CAMA", "60", "/60 °C".
Six right cards retain the same order and all their labels: top row PAUSAR | CANCELAR, middle row MACROS | EXCLUIR, bottom row AJUSTES IMPRESION | PARADA.
All these elements must fit cleanly with readable typography; no overlaps, truncation, missing buttons, invented widgets, new titles, or altered readings. No header anywhere. One screenshot only, no comparison panels, no device frame, no exterior captions.
